model_only.label: Model only
model_only.description: Bet when the model's probability beats the average price by 5%+.

blended.label: Model + market blend
blended.description: Average the model with the market's de-vigged probability, bet at average price with 3%+ edge.

line_shopping.label: Line shopping
line_shopping.description: No model: bet when the best available price beats the market consensus fair price by 3%+.

shopping_confirmed.label: Line shopping + model agrees
shopping_confirmed.description: Line shopping, but only when the model also rates the outcome at least as likely as the market.
